_about: Verified UK-DALE unseen-house (House 2) test metrics for the shipped ML/NILM/*.pth checkpoints. Recomputed from the held-out test predictions with ML/NILM/eval/verify_f1.py. See RESULTS.md.
protocol: unseen-house: train on all UK-DALE houses except House 2; test only on House 2 (kettle/fridge/washing_machine/television). Appliances present in a single house use an 80/20 chronological split.

caveats.hair_dryer_iron: Hair dryer (43,200 test samples) and iron (960) have small test supports in UK-DALE House 2 — their F1 is noisier than kettle/fridge/washing_machine.
caveats.ground_truth: These are dataset-vs-model accuracy figures, not live-demo accuracy. Real-home performance requires sensor calibration and fine-tuning (see plan/03).
